description: Explicit structure detector for EXPANSION_BREAKOUT. Requires sequential observation of three named phases: COMPRESSION, RELEASE, and EXPANSION_HOLD. No threshold-only entry is permitted without structural evidence of all three phases in sequence.
structural_contract: A signal is valid only when all three phases pass independently. Removing any single phase check must suppress the signal for at least the test cases in entry_breakout_v2_validation.json.

phases.description: Price must have been coiling in a tight range prior to the breakout bar. This confirms a real energy buildup, not just a threshold crossing on a wide-ranging bar.
structural_requirements: At least compression_min_bars (default 5) valid bars must be in the lookback window
phases.what_this_rules_out: Breakouts from wide trending bars where there was no consolidation preceding the escape

phases.description: The current close must have escaped the compression zone with a directional close — not just a wick through. Both conditions are required: minimum escape distance AND directional close (green for LONG, red for SHORT).
structural_requirements: For LONG: close > zone_high + release_min_atr * atr (default release_min_atr=0.05)
For LONG: close > prev_close (directional close — no bearish-close breakout)
For SHORT: close < zone_low - release_min_atr * atr
One of [LONG, SHORT] must satisfy both sub-conditions simultaneously
phases.fail_condition: Neither direction satisfies both escape+directional simultaneously → signal suppressed, fail_phase=RELEASE
what_this_rules_out: Wick-through breakouts where the close retreated back into the zone
Indecision bars that technically cleared the edge but closed against direction

phases.description: The breakout must show holding evidence — the move is not an immediate spike rejection. Holding is confirmed by EITHER the prior close also outside the zone, OR the current close being clearly away from the zone edge.
structural_requirements: For LONG: prior_close > zone_high (prior bar closed outside) OR close >= zone_high + hold_clear_atr * atr (default 0.15)
For SHORT: prior_close < zone_low OR close <= zone_low - hold_clear_atr * atr
At least one holding condition must be True
phases.fail_condition: Neither prior_outside nor clearly_away is True → signal suppressed, fail_phase=EXPANSION_HOLD
phases.what_this_rules_out: Immediate spike reversals where the current bar escaped briefly but prior bar was still inside the zone and the close is barely past the edge

compression_window.description: Number of bars used to measure the compression zone (excludes current bar)

compression_ratio_max.description: Maximum zone_range/atr for the compression to qualify

compression_min_bars.description: Minimum valid bars required in the compression window

release_min_atr.description: Minimum escape distance beyond zone edge (fraction of ATR)

hold_clear_atr.description: Clear distance from zone edge defining a 'hard hold' (fraction of ATR)

max_freshness_atr.description: Maximum freshness (distance from zone / ATR); rejects stale setups

spread_limit_pips.description: Hard spread gate; pre-structural, independent of phases

result_fields.is_valid: bool — True only when all three phases confirmed
result_fields.freshness_atr: float — distance from zone edge in ATR units
result_fields.fail_phase: str | None — name of first phase that failed

what_this_is_not: NOT: close > zone_high + buffer alone (current threshold-only COMPRESSION_EXPANSION check)
NOT: additive heuristic score >= threshold (current _infer_trade_family fallback)
NOT: macro_bias alone without zone escape
NOT: near_edge softening without compression evidence (current near_edge=0.12*atr relaxation)

separation_from_v1.v1_mechanism: close > zone_high + PC1_ENTRY_BREAK_BUFFER_ATR * atr (0.00 default, so literally just close > zone_high), with soft extension: close near edge + bias_supportive
separation_from_v1.v2_mechanism: Three sequential phases: compression proved, directional close escape, holding evidence. All required.
separation_from_v1.key_difference: v1 fires on any close above zone_high (with optional bias softening). v2 requires prior coil AND directional close AND hold. v1 is a position threshold. v2 is a structural sequence.
